descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
A lone wanderer on the edge of space, a mystery as old as the universe itself, and one little robot who just wants to make the tea.

Into Black is a first-person action adventure that takes you into the depths of a mysterious alien planet. Explore the darkness, mine resources, and fight alien beasts as you try to repair your ship and escape.

[media]

The **Ascension Update (v1.6)** adds smarter enemies, refined gunplay, new smoke trails, shootable critters, improved co-op, better Singularity balance, and many fixes and polish updates. Expect smoother performance, improved UI, and small visual touches throughout.

Designed for Meta Quest and optimized for Quest 3 and Quest 3S, featuring a rich story, multiple modes, and solo or co-op play.

**Features**

**Single or Co-op action:** Play the full campaign with up to 3 friends or take it on solo.

**Fight to survive:** Deadly alien creatures lurk in the dark. Master a range of powerful weapons to endure.

[media]

**Fully voice-acted campaign:** Follow deep space scavenger Ben Mitchell and his droid companion as they uncover a mystery at the heart of the universe.

**Explore 20+ levels:** Journey through magma chambers, sunken caves, and alien nests, now refined in the Ascension Update.

**Gather resources & upgrade tools:** Mine, scavenge, and loot to upgrade your character and repair your ship.

[media]

**"Singularity" PvPvE mode:** Face up to 11 players in a shrinking maze. Gather loot, form alliances, and survive, now with improved balance, scoring, and feedback in the Ascension Update.

[media]
